output:
I'll start by looking at the workspace layout, the docs, and the triage guide.

That call had malformed arguments, so I'll retry it with valid JSON.

I found four defects in the 2.4.0 code, fixed them in `/app/shelfmark`, and wrote `/app/cache-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json`. `python3 -m unittest` still passes (30 tests). With all four fixes, the replay of 2.4.0 traffic gives a hit rate of about 59%, in line with the 55–60% daytime rate before the deploy.

I counted each defect by replaying the 2.4.0 traffic (from `2027-05-03T14:00:05Z`) with only that fix applied. `requests` is then the number of logged misses that became hits.

| Class | Location | Defect | Requests | First |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key-params` | `shelfmark/keys.py:19` | Parameters starting with `utm_` were not left out of the key. | 764 | `r0009011` |
| `key-vary` | `shelfmark/locale.py:38` | A primary-subtag match returned the client's own range (for example `pt-pt`) instead of the supported locale (`pt-BR`), so one entry became many. | 1418 | `r0006627` |
| `invalidation` | `shelfmark/cache.py:23` | The purge prefix `books\|12` also matched books `120` and `1203`. It now ends in `\|`. | 16 | `r0007206` |
| `ttl` | `shelfmark/config.py:39` | A bare integer ttl was used as milliseconds instead of seconds. Revision 43 (search `ttl = 600`, applied at 20:00 on May 3) therefore gave a 0.6 s ttl. | 274 | `r0011087` |

The replay of the unfixed code matched the log exactly for 2.4.0, which is why I trust the per-defect counts. I found no `routing`, `capacity` or `clock` defect in the code or in the logs.

cd /app; cat docs/overview.md docs/cache.md docs/config.md docs/locale.md docs/operations.md docs/changelog.md
cd /app; for f in shelfmark/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat -n $f; done

cd /app; cat tools/replay.py; cat logs/deploy.log logs/config.log logs/ops.log; grep -v stats logs/service.log | head -50; head -c 1500 logs/upstream.log; cat config/cache.toml; ls tests; git status 2>&1 | head -3

cd /app; python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff | tail -5; python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff | awk '{print $5,$6}' | sort | uniq -c; python3 tools/replay.py --diff | tail -1; python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5

cd /app; cat logs/access/*.log | awk '{print $3, $4}' | sed -E 's/[0-9]+/N/g; s/\?.*/?.../' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -30; cat logs/access/*.log | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq -c; cat logs/access/*.log | grep -v ' GET /\(books\|authors\)/[0-9]*\(?\|\ \)' | grep -v ' GET /search' | awk '{print $3,$4,$6}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40

cd /app; cat logs/access/*.log | awk '{print $1}' | python3 -c "
import sys
prev=''
n=0
for l in sys.stdin:
    l=l.strip()
    if l<prev: n+=1; print('out of order',prev,l)
    prev=l
print(n)" | tail -5; grep -c 'books/0' logs/access/*.log; cat logs/access/*.log | grep -E 'GET /(books|authors)/[^ ?]*[^0-9 ?]' | head

mkdir -p /tmp/v && cd /tmp/v && rm -rf * && for v in utm loc purge ttl; do mkdir $v; cp -r /app/shelfmark $v/; done
cd /tmp/v
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
def sub(v,f,a,b):
    p=f'/tmp/v/{v}/shelfmark/{f}'; s=open(p).read(); assert a in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(a,b))
sub('utm','keys.py','        if name in cfg.ignore_params:','        if name in cfg.ignore_params or name.startswith("utm_"):')
sub('loc','locale.py','                return rng','                return loc')
sub('purge','cache.py','prefix = f"{route}|{ident}"','prefix = f"{route}|{ident}|"')
sub('ttl','config.py','        return int(value)','        return int(value) * 1000')
EOF
for v in utm loc purge ttl; do echo == $v; python3 /app/tools/replay.py --pkg /tmp/v/$v --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff > /tmp/v/$v.out; tail -1 /tmp/v/$v.out; grep -c 'logged=miss replay=hit' /tmp/v/$v.out; grep 'logged=miss replay=hit' /tmp/v/$v.out | head -1; grep -c 'logged=hit replay=miss' /tmp/v/$v.out; done
cd /app; cat logs/access/*.log | sed -E 's/.* lang=//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -80; cat logs/access/*.log | sed -E 's/.* lang=//' | sort -u | wc -l
cd /app; cat logs/access/*.log | grep -o ' GET [^ ]*' | grep -o '?.*' | tr '&?' '\n\n' | sed -E 's/=.*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn; cat config/history/r04*.toml | head -80

cd /app; python3 - <<'EOF'
def sub(f,a,b):
    p=f'/app/shelfmark/{f}'; s=open(p).read(); assert s.count(a)==1; open(p,'w').write(s.replace(a,b))
sub('keys.py','        if name in cfg.ignore_params:','        if name in cfg.ignore_params or name.startswith("utm_"):')
sub('locale.py','                return rng','                return loc')
sub('cache.py','prefix = f"{route}|{ident}"','prefix = f"{route}|{ident}|"')
sub('config.py','        return int(value)','        return int(value) * 1000')
EOF
python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -3
python3 tools/replay.py --since 2027-05-03T14:00:05.000Z --diff > /tmp/all.out; tail -1 /tmp/all.out; grep -c 'logged=hit replay=miss' /tmp/all.out
for v in utm loc purge ttl; do echo $v; grep 'logged=miss replay=hit' /tmp/v/$v.out | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1; done
